Hello Bill,

I hope you are having a great week. I am Marcos Gonzalez, Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, a D.C.-based government contracting firm. I wanted to congratulate you on the upcoming LOXSAT mission. As you gear up for the payload launch in July, I wonder if you have encountered any issues with NASA that have potentially derailed your contract. Have you benefitted at all from NASA's move to commercial purchasing methods?

At GovSpring Legal, among other things, we advise federal, state and local contractors on how to properly assert complex data rights so the government does not overstep when claiming rights to commercial technology. We have also drafted codes of conduct, such as the one you would need to perform on this contract.

I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself and see how we can support ETA as you continue to support NASA's mission. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerk, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Warmly,
Marcos Gonzalez
Managing Attorney
GovSpring Legal
www.govspringlegal.com
